description: This file contains compatibility and schema generation utilities for FastAPI and Pydantic, including custom schema classes, model field handling, and model introspection functions.

classes.name: GenerateJsonSchema
classes.description: Custom schema class extending Pydantic's _GenerateJsonSchema with additional bytes schema handling.

classes.name: ModelField
classes.description: Represents a model field with methods for validation, serialization, and schema generation.

methods.name: bytes_schema
methods.description: Generates JSON schema for bytes type with support for base64 encoding.

methods.name: asdict
methods.description: Converts a FieldInfo object into a dictionary of its attributes.

methods.name: get_default
methods.description: Returns the default value for the field, or Undefined if required.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a value against the field's type adapter.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes a value to Python data types.

methods.name: serialize_json
methods.description: Serializes a value directly to JSON bytes.

methods.name: get_schema_from_model_field
methods.description: Generates JSON schema for a model field, with optional overrides.

methods.name: get_definitions
methods.description: Generates schema definitions for a set of fields and models.

methods.name: is_scalar_field
methods.description: Checks if a field's annotation is scalar and not a body parameter.

methods.name: copy_field_info
methods.description: Creates a new FieldInfo by merging existing info with a new annotation.

methods.name: serialize_sequence_value
methods.description: Serializes a sequence value based on the field's annotation type.

methods.name: get_missing_field_error
methods.description: Returns an error dict for a missing required field.

methods.name: create_body_model
methods.description: Creates a Pydantic model class from a sequence of ModelFields.

methods.name: get_model_fields
methods.description: Extracts ModelFields from a Pydantic model class.

methods.name: get_cached_model_fields
methods.description: Cached version of get_model_fields for performance.

methods.name: get_model_name_map
methods.description: Creates a mapping from model names to model classes, with normalized names.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_model
methods.description: Recursively extracts all models referenced by a given model.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_annotation
methods.description: Extracts models from type annotations.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_field
methods.description: Extracts models from a ModelField.

methods.name: get_flat_models_from_fields
methods.description: Extracts models from a sequence of ModelFields.

methods.name: _regenerate_error_with_loc
methods.description: Adjusts error locations by prefixing with a given location path.
